title: Anis was a great guide!...
text: Anis was a great guide! He was very friendly, and knowledgeable, and provided insightful descriptions on Alhambra, its cultural importance and historical significance, while being very efficient with his time management.
author: Kasema_R

title: Fully recommended!!
text:
It was an amazing 3h15 tour where we learned not only about the history of the Alhambra, but also about the nature around and curious facts. 
Our guide was Almudena and we loved it!!! Very friendly and professional at all times, we were impressed with everything you knew! 
It was definitely worth it and we are very happy, exceeded our expectations!
